content:
Priya Nair: Quick draft one-pager for enterprise security + SLA audience. Need benchmark callout, webinar plan, and inbound routing for private/VPC requests.

Ben K: Draft in Drive: https://drive.redwood/sec-onepager-v2. Headline idea: 'Secure. Predictable. Low-cost inference for regulated teams.'

Lena Ortiz: Bench details to surface: mixed chat + long-form generation (2k tokens), baseline median ~280ms -> our median ~95ms at 4 streams; ~40% lower token cost using batching + prefix cache. Add tiny methodology note.

Chris W: Inbound routing rules: if lead mentions any of [security, vpc, private-deploy, sla] -> tag enterprise-security, route to AE+SE, add 'schedule-compliance-workshop' task. Also add form checkbox: 'Private deployment required?'.

Priya Nair: Webinar structure: 20m benchmark walkthrough, 25m live Q&A with SE & Solutions, 15m breakout for compliance/legal. CTA: 'Request a private demo + SLA review'. A/B test compliance vs product subject lines.

Ben K: Layout: top 1-line problem, benchmark callout (numbers + tiny methodology), deployment matrix (hosted/dedicated/private) with SLA bullets, bottom CTA + routing snippet.

Priya Nair: Action items: Ben finalize copy by EOD; Lena produce 2 charts (median+p99, cost); Chris update inbound form and routing tags; I'll assemble and schedule a 20-min review tomorrow.

marketing-bot: Reminder set: 'Security one-pager review' tomorrow 10:30 AM PT.
